messages:
sam: Heads-up 10am PT launch for the Geo Split test (US East vs US West) + retarget refresh. Need final decisions: negative keyword list, lead routing, and dynamic creative rules.

rachel: Negative keywords ready but want to add a competitor-brand exclusion and broad generic terms. Proposed list:
```
- free
- tutorial
- competitorname
- jobs
- cheap
```
Keep it conservative for longtail.

devon: Budget allocation: total daily = $1500. Split 60/40 east/west. Start with 50% of each region in search-core, 30% in retarget, 20% in longtail. We'll auto-shift +10% to the region with lower CPA after 6h.

emily: Lead routing: push leads with lead_score >= 0.6 into SDR queue webhook (/webhooks/sdr) with payload: utm_campaign, creative_id, gclid, lead_score. If lead_score < 0.6 -> route to nurture flow. Also require GA4 conversion event present before routing.

ads-bot: Performance snapshot (last 7d): avg CPA retarget = $18, search-core = $32, longtail = $45. Top converting creatives have CTA "Start free" and short bullets.

sam: Add frequency cap for retarget: 4 impressions/day and reduce cart-retarget bids by 15% during first 24h to avoid cannibalizing search.

rachel: Creative plan 1 variants per region: headline pairs adapted for regional copy (e.g., "Low-latency inference" -> "Industry-grade low latency"). Keep image A as control for 12h then enable auto-opt.

devon: Automation rules I'll apply:
```
1) IF region_a.cpa < region_b.cpa AND time > 6h THEN shift budget(region_a,+10%)
2) IF avg_cpc(search-core) > 5.5 THEN reduce bids 15% AND notify #marketing
3) IF conversions < 2 after 8h THEN pause longtail -> reallocate to retarget
```
I'll stage in Editor and snapshot changes.

emily: QA checklist before flip: 1) UTM tags = utm_source=ad, utm_campaign=geo_split_apr, utm_content={creative_id} 2) GA4 event 'lead_submitted' fires with gclid 3) webhook auth token present. I'll validate at 09:50.

sam: Also add negative placement rule to exclude low-quality apps/sites for display retarget.

rachel: Quick note - add a small manual bid bump for top-performing query list: ["brand term", "platform inference"]. +12% only after 4h if CTR > 1.2%.

ads-bot: Alert scheduled: Geo-Split-Launch -> #marketing-notifs at 10:00 PT. First telemetry at 10:15 then 10:30, 10:45, hourly after.

devon: Pushing changes at 09:55. Editor diff link: editor://diff/geo-split-2170024680.

emily: Confirmed webhooks & GA4 pings. Payload sample OK. Will monitor event to ensure no duplicates.

sam: All set from my side. If the reallocation rule triggers, keep a safety cap: max shift = 15% per 6h.

rachel: :rocket:

devon: :thumbsup:

emily: :eyes:

ads-bot: Launch executed at 10:00 PT. Initial spend 10:00-10:15 = $82 (5.4% of daily). Monitoring...
